Criterion: Verify that pressurization rate control is available to preclude pressure surges in the cockpit, control station and avionics environment. Standard: Pressure schedules are defined for the air vehicle system to minimize discomfort to any crew and passengers and prevent hypoxia. Pressurization system reacts quickly to changes in flight conditions, and air conditioning flow rates are maintained at the required pressure schedule to ensure safe operations. Protection from excessive pressure differentials and partial decompression is provided for crew safety and to prevent air vehicle system or equipment structural damage. If the air vehicle system is pressurized in flight, pressure is relieved prior to crew exit or equipment access to prevent personal injury or structural damage. Method of Compliance: a. Analysis and flight tests verify pressure schedule and tolerance requirements for occupied and avionics compartments. b. Ground test is performed to show relief methods for adverse pressurization conditions.
